name: claude-hooks
description: TypeScript hooks for Claude Code - pre-bundled, zero runtime deps

scripts.build: esbuild src/*.ts --bundle --metafile=.build-meta.json --inject:src/lib/trace-boot.ts --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --preserve-symlinks --banner:js="import{createRequire as __hookCreateRequire}from'module';const require=__hookCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/normalize-dist-paths.mjs && node scripts/write-build-inputs.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run check
